authorization: User explicitly chose prospective protocol revision to assess three folds while retaining real evidence and zero leakage in this conversation.

design_context.reason: Only three indivisible components contain a positive MIC label. Assess a smaller exploratory validation design without changing evidence, molecules, similarity, or label boundaries.

scope: small-sample exploratory E. coli MIC classification; no dual-task, clinical efficacy, external validation or publication authorization
raw_measurement_normalization: linear canonical sequence molecular weight; micromolar to micrograms per milliliter

molecule_domain.modifications: none; sequences with unsupported/noncanonical modifications are excluded

evidence_requirements: primary experimental MIC observation for the declared peptide sequence
identified Escherichia coli target strain or isolate
raw value, unit, and traceable primary study reference
binary label independently re-derived from the raw assay observation
duplicate_policy: merge exact sequences; opposite derived MIC labels are a blocking unresolved conflict

similarity.identity: number of identical aligned residues divided by number of alignment columns
similarity.grouping: transitive connected components; every component remains within one fold

primary_study_grouping: All molecule and observation study aliases are joined transitively with all-member homology components; no study crosses folds.
release_gate: This amendment authorizes only one fixed three-fold feasibility audit. Training additionally requires a complete primary-evidence release and a separate immutable training protocol. Any failed scientific gate keeps training blocked.
